app.title: Simple-Todo
app.tagline: Hand a list to someone standing next to you — no internet needed.

identity.heading: Who you are
identity.explain: You can use the app like this. But if you clear this browser, your lists are gone. A passkey keeps them and shows people who they got a list from.
identity.passkeyHidden: A passkey exists on this device. Lists you made with it stay hidden until you restore it.
identity.useOnDevice: Use the passkey on this device

list.heading: Your list
list.example: Or use the example list (10 jobs)
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {1 entry} other {# entries}}
list.onlyYouCanWrite: Only you can add to this list. Others can read it.

transfer.heading: Give this list to someone
transfer.holdUp: Hold this up so the other phone can scan it. Then tap “Scan their reply”.
transfer.showBack: Show this back to them so they can finish.
transfer.sent: Sent “{name}”. They decide whether to keep it.
transfer.linkSummary: Or send it as a link
transfer.staticCode: Static code — the other phone can scan it with its camera
transfer.staticCodeHint: One picture instead of a moving one, so a normal camera can read it and open the link. The connection is a little less reliable.

errors.notReady: The app is still starting. Please try again in a moment.
errors.noWritePermission: You cannot add to this list — it belongs to someone else.
